deploy-bot: STARTING PROD DEPLOY · service=redwood-inference-api env=prod tag=v1.22.0 commit=3b7f2a9 author=Kevin (https://git.example.com/redwood/repo/commit/3b7f2a9) PR=#842 (https://git.example.com/redwood/repo/pull/842) change-window=2026-03-20T02:00-03:00UTC rollout=canary:10% -> 100% at +5m · id=DPL-20260320-1711002345
Andrew: @deploy-bot ack, I'll watch canary and smoke tests.
Clare: Quick Q — any DB/schema migration in this PR?
Sasha: No DB migrations mentioned in PR description. It's mostly request routing + perf tweaks.
Andrew: Running quick smoke: ```curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.prod/redwood/health``` -> `200 0.142`
deploy-bot: CANARY STEP COMPLETE · canary=10% duration=3m metrics: p95_latency=142ms errors=0.2% (alert_threshold=0.1%) see dashboard: https://observability.example.com/d/DPL-20260320-1711002345
Clare: I'm seeing a small spike of 500s in api-prod-canary logs around +2m. Not huge but above baseline. Suggest pausing rollout. @oncall-bot please hold the rollout. :warning:
oncall-bot: HOLD REQUEST RECEIVED · pausing rollout for DPL-20260320-1711002345 per Clare. Initiating investigation hooks (logs, traces, recent commits).
Andrew: Reproducing locally against canary: `POST /v1/generate` with a short prompt returns 500 with exception `ModelShardError: missing kv-cache` — that aligns with a shard pinning change in 3b7f2a9.
Clare: OK let's rollback to previous stable tag v1.21.9 (commit=a1d9c3f). We should pin prod to that until Kevin can patch. @deploy-bot run rollback to tag v1.21.9.
oncall-bot: Rollback approved by Clare. Kicking rollback workflow. ETA ~2m.
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK STARTED · target_tag=v1.21.9 commit=a1d9c3f author=Kevin (https://git.example.com/redwood/repo/commit/a1d9c3f) PR=#821 (https://git.example.com/redwood/repo/pull/821) reason="canary error spike: ModelShardError" rollback-id=RBK-20260320-1711002345
Andrew: Running the rollback command now on the infra console: ```kubectl -n prod set image deploy/redwood-api redwood-api=registry.example.com/redwood:v1.21.9 && kubectl rollout status deploy/redwood-api -n prod```
Kevin: I'm on it, will follow up with a patch PR. I'll also pin the release in the release config: `infra/releases/prod_pin.txt -> v1.21.9`
deploy-bot: ROLLBACK COMPLETE · success=true target_tag=v1.21.9 commit=a1d9c3f duration=1m48s all_checks=green monitoring: errors back to baseline. Closing DPL-20260320-1711002345
Clare: Thanks everyone. Please add a short release-note entry: "rollback v1.22.0 -> v1.21.9 due to canary ModelShardError, patch incoming (Kevin)" and pin the commit in the Release Notes doc.
Kevin: Will do — creating PR for the patch and a postmortem doc. Linking here when ready.
Sasha: Added a short line to the release notes doc and flagged owner=Kevin.
Andrew: LGTM. Marking the incident as a deploy rollback, no user-facing downtime observed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: ARCHIVE: DPL-20260320-1711002345 rolled back to v1.21.9 (a1d9c3f). Notifying release-triage.
